## Summary

**The engine schedules under honest capacity.** `next`/`claim`/`launch`
enforce `Pool{key, limit}` against `max_concurrent_runs`: a pool misses
`model_snapshot:`/`environment_class:`/`participant:` keys by probing
the arm's bound factor levels (never a policy the arm doesn't carry), a
saturated pool answers `PoolExhausted`/`Wait` — never over capacity —
and every consume/release pair lands `pool_consumed`/`pool_released` on
the launch/settle rows. `start_stagger_ms` spaces concurrent launches;
`pause` quiesces `claim`/`launch` while in-flight work settles, and
`paused`/`resumed` carry the probe tag (AC-R-2.10.3-10/-14).

**Hosted participants launch through an SPI, not a dependency.**
`launch` routes hosted-level arms through `HostedLauncher` (a trait the
caller supplies — `hh-experiment` gains no `hh-hosting` edge, CC6);
hosted rows stamp `participant_class = hosted` +
`limits_enforced = partial` (never `full` — the SPI can't promise what
the host doesn't enforce). Component-level hosted factors refuse
`InadmissibleFactor` at `register`; configuration-level hosted factors
are capability-gated by the arm's `participant_descriptor` (an
unresolvable coordinate is never coerced — ADR-0152's closed verdict
vocabulary). `ArmSpec` gains `inference_budget:
Option<ContentAddress>` — the M3 third term (`{declared, consumed,
inference_budget}`); `None` is unconstrained, never zero
(AC-R-2.10.3-3).

**Bundles scope.** `BundleManifest.bundle_kind ∈ {run, arm, experiment,
lineage}`; scoped assembly composes child bundles by `version_id` with
the child's manifest bytes carried verbatim in the member set
(`contains` is integrity, not a pointer). S9 `cross_section` runs on
every validation: `RowOrphan`, `DeclarationMissing`,
`ContainmentMismatch`, `UnmatchedBudget`, `PreRegistrationLate` — with
`results.arm` required on `kind = arm` only (ADR-0293 D2). The
eight-status ladder (`assembled` → `validated`/`attested`/`reproduced`
→ `published`/`restricted`; `superseded`, `retracted`) is
evidence-gated: `set_status` demands the valid report / the attestation
on the manifest `version_id` / the independent `ReproReport` / the
successor pointer; the status book is a cache folded from ledger
`STATUS_EVENT` rows, rebuildable from the authoritative source
(AC-R-2.9.3-7/-11).

**Import lifts honestly; export reports its losses.** `kernel.import`
is the general head: `ledger_native` lifts the decoded bundle into a
new run; `harbor_trial_dir`/`harbor_job_dir` lift foreign trees into
hosted `R0` bundles — `unverified` authority, `import(...)` origin,
`foreign:<path>` members, lock-file digest claims, and
`ForeignIntegrityMismatch` claim conflicts (recorded, never coerced).
`export` targets `ledger_native`, `harbor_job_dir`, and
`interchange_trajectory` (product granularity + loss listing); a
`PublicationPolicy` withholds L2-class members into the loss report and
`measurement.export.delivered` lands per subject run (AC-R-2.9.3-8/-9/-
10).

**`fetch` is pool-backed, remote transports deferred.** `locations[]`
members materialise `bundle/` + `pool/` through a `Fetcher` seam;
remote transports refuse `Refused{transport_pending}` — DF-S4.2-1.

**Boundary.** `kernel.{bundle(kind, contains[]), validate, diff, fetch,
export, status, set_status, attest, audit_bundle, supersede, migrate,
lineage, import}` are live Group-M ops (schema source `ops.rs`;
generated client + schema export regenerated — check-drift green).
`lab.experiment.close` composes the experiment-bundle assembly at the
boundary and returns `bundle_id`; `hh-experiment` stays fs-free
(ADR-0293 D5/D6).

**The three Phase-4 recipes.** `delegation-v1`,
`value-of-compute-v1` (with the iso-cost companion over
`inference_budget`), and `coordination-topology-v1` register, expand,
and run under `matched_total` (AC-R-2.10.3-14).

## Tests

- `crates/hh-bundle/tests/s4_2.rs` — 16 tests: scoped assembly for
  `arm`/`experiment`/`lineage`, `contains` verbatim-integrity, S9's five
  typed findings + the clean pass, `diff` member/field/level/policy
  deltas, supersede/migrate `derived_from` + version-id recompute,
  attestation verify under the key table, audit subject/link flags,
  export lowering + policy withhold, `fetch` digest-check +
  missing-bytes refusal, both codecs round-tripping a scoped bundle,
  and `harbor_trial_dir` lifting to a hosted `unverified` bundle with
  the `ForeignIntegrityMismatch` conflict recorded.
- `crates/hh-results/tests/status.rs` — 3 tests: evidence-gated
  transitions (invalid/premature refusals), the publish/restrict toggle
  + terminal rules, the ledger-fold book rebuild.
- `crates/hh-experiment/tests/engine.rs` — 29 tests: pool serialization
  + consumed/released rows, claim expiry, hosted launch with
  `participant_class`/`limits_enforced` stamps, `InadmissibleFactor`,
  pause/resume probe tags, close recheck + `bundle_assembled`.
- `crates/hh-lab/tests/exemplars.rs` — the three new recipes register,
  expand, and pin (`delegation_v1_registers_and_expands`,
  `value_of_compute_v1_registers_with_iso_companion`,
  `coordination_topology_v1_registers_and_expands`).
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/conformance.rs` —
  `s42_scoped_bundle_validate_status_and_lifecycle` end-to-end through
  the boundary: scoped `kernel.bundle` → `kernel.validate` (S9 rows) →
  `kernel.set_status` ladder + gated refusal → `kernel.attest` →
  `kernel.supersede`/`lineage` → `kernel.export` `harbor_job_dir` →
  `kernel.import` foreign round-trip (`unverified`, distinct
  `bundle_id`, `lifecycle.run.imported` receipt) → unknown format
  typed-refused.

## Out of scope

Remote `fetch` transports (DF-S4.2-1 — WS-L6 trust fields spec-parked);
the remaining declared foreign vocabularies `swebench_submission`,
`inspect_eval_log`, `in_toto_bundle`, `telemetry_trace` (DF-S4.2-2 —
each lift is a codec + claim-set ruling owned by its protocol-edge
ticket); `lab.producer.{declare,bind,record_analysis}` (S4.3's
results-store slice); the `closed`-row audit-field cap at exemplar
scale (DF-S3.12b-1, inherited unchanged).
